limits: Development gates are not an independent holdout or a live deployment decision.
No access to 2025-26 is reported; only generated receipts were read to prepare this record.
Source capture and causal filtering do not establish historically available deadline rosters.
Historical reconstructed populations and current-roster retention can omit players.
Origins and growing training sets overlap; support counts must not be summed as unique players.
Retained history means retained causal fixture rows, not a complete playing career or proof of the cause of GW1 error.
Current GW1 role NLL, Brier and minutes MAE worsen for the retained-support candidate.
Shared q and unchanged within-role laws limit the changes each candidate can make.
Temperature prefix-to-full-head transfer is a modeling assumption.
There is no calibrated-probability, statistical-significance, global component superiority or realized FPL gain claim.
Saved baseline aggregates and diagnostic bytes match; raw old prediction matrices were not retained.
No new fit, solver, test, provider request or input-data read was performed during report preparation.

gates_note.why_50_against_35: Both runs hold the same 35 numerical gates: 30 role gates (role NLL and Brier for ALL and the four positions in the historical, current and overall cohorts), 4 MAE gates (points and minutes for historical and current ALL) and 1 strict overall ALL role NLL gain. The temperature run also records 15 separate paired-population gates, one per cohort and view, so it counts 50. The retained run counts 35 because its acceptance function refuses to compare unless all 65 origin and position populations are exactly equal, and folds completeness (every required origin paired) and a nonempty role population into each of its other gates.
gates_note.overall_ALL_role_gates: Each runner holds the ALL view of every cohort to no worse (threshold = base), including overall ALL role NLL and Brier. The written acceptance lists in both protocols and in math100-role-retained-support.md name no worse only for historical and current ALL, and a strict gain for overall ALL role NLL, which implies its no worse gate. No written item covers overall ALL role Brier; its gates carry written_acceptance_item null.
gates_note.temperature_failure_on_the_unwritten_gat: One of the four temperature failures, overall ALL role Brier (candidate_minus_base 2.603036450860019e-05), is that unwritten gate. The other three are written gates and reject the candidate without it: historical ALL minutes MAE, current ALL minutes MAE and current ALL role Brier. The retained candidate passes the unwritten gate.
gates_note.temperature_population_gates_unwritten: The temperature protocol's acceptance list does not name its 15 population gates either. All 15 pass, so they decide nothing.
